"""Validate actual restored smoke states and an immutable live training prefix."""

import math
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
import torch
from review_regional_dc_trial import equal_tree
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_regional_dc_trial import classes

root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V158-regional-dc-v1')
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
assert not (root/'readiness-audit-v1.json').exists()
smoke=read(root/'smoke-result-v1.json')
assert smoke['steps']==10 and smoke['counts']==smoke['updates']=={'dc-control':10,'dc-regret':10}
assert ref(smoke['checkpoint']['path'])==smoke['checkpoint']
state=torch.load(smoke['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
assert state['step']==10
states=0
for label,arm in state['arms'].items():
    assert len(state['optimizers'][label]['state'])==arm['parameter_tensors']
    assert min(smoke['parameter_maximum_gradients'][label].values())>0
    for item in state['optimizers'][label]['state'].values():
        assert float(item['step'])==10 and all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in item.values())
        states+=1
    for key in ['models','emas']:
        module=classes()[label](**state['module_config'])
        module.load_state_dict(state[key][label],strict=True)
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for v in module.state_dict().values())
assert states==90
old=read(Path(plan['previous'])/'smoke-result-v1.json')
assert ref(old['checkpoint']['path'])==old['checkpoint']
prior=torch.load(old['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
for key in ['models','emas','optimizers']:
    assert equal_tree(state[key]['dc-control'],prior[key]['local-risk'])
for row,expected in zip(smoke['trace'],old['trace'],strict=True):
    assert row['arms']['dc-control']==expected['arms']['local-risk']
snapshot=root/'readiness-training-prefix-v1.jsonl'
assert not snapshot.exists()
raw=(root/'train-trace-v1.jsonl').read_bytes()
complete=raw[:raw.rfind(b'\n')+1]
snapshot.write_bytes(complete)
import json
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in complete.splitlines()]
reference=read(plan['baseline_training']['path'])['trace']
assert len(rows)>0
for index,row in enumerate(rows):
    assert row['step']==index+1 and row['batch']==reference[index]['batch']
    assert row['arms']['dc-control']==reference[index]['arms']['local-risk']
    for arm in row['arms'].values():assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in arm.values())
status=read(root/'status-v1.json');post=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
observed=[]
for role,owner in [('controller',status['owner']),('train-worker',status['child']),('post-controller',post['owner'])]:
    process=psutil.Process(owner['pid']);assert abs(process.create_time()-owner['created'])<.01
    assert process.status() not in ['dead','zombie']
    observed.append({'role':role,**owner,'process_status':process.status(),'argv':process.cmdline()})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
save(root/'readiness-audit-v1.json',{
    'status':'pass-actual-smoke-state-control-replay-and-live-prefix',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'plan':ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),
    'smoke':ref(root/'smoke-result-v1.json'),'restored_control_raw_EMA_Adam_exact_V157':True,
    'finite_Adam_states_at10':states,'strict_raw_EMA_CPU_loads':4,
    'all90_parameter_tensors_have_finite_nonzero_prefix_gradients':True,
    'live_prefix':ref(snapshot),'complete_rows':len(rows),'exact_control_trace_rows':len(rows),
    'observed_live_owners':observed,'CUDA_initialized':False,'new_forward_calls':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Actual genuine8+2 restored smoke checkpoint verified on CPU,not final quality. Immutable completed live-prefix bytes and all matching V157 dc-control rows. All3 owners confirmed live by PID/create-time. No completion,performance or native-viewing claim.'})
print('PASS four strict smoke loads,90 finite Adam states,exact V157 smoke model/EMA/Adam,',len(rows),'exact live control rows and3 actual live owners')
